content.text: That fix worked — I'll finish drafting the rest of the orders.

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H2","instruction_en":"Please check the wooden doorway sill in the walkthrough by hand: stand a tape on the walkway floor and read the height at the top of the sill, and write it down. Do not build or buy anything yet.","instruction_zh":"請用手動方式確認走道門口的木門檻：將捲尺立在走道地面，量到門檻頂端的高度並記錄。先不要施工或購買材料。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Secure or remove the red patterned rug against the wall in the walkthrough, and flatten its curled edge.","instruction_zh":"請將走道靠牆的紅色花紋地毯固定或收走，並把捲起的邊角鋪平。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H4","instruction_en":"Clear the black cable from the walkway and doorway threshold in the walkthrough and route it away from the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將走道及門檻上的黑色電線清除，移離走道。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H5","instruction_en":"Clear the black cable from the tiled walkway floor in the walkthrough and move it away from the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地面上的黑色電線清除，移離走道。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H6","instruction_en":"Remove the lace-up shoes from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and place them in a shoe cabinet off the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地面上的繫帶鞋子移走，放到走道外的鞋櫃。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H7","instruction_en":"Remove the shoes from the wooden floor in the walkthrough and place them off the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將走道木地板上的鞋子移走，放到走道外。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H8","instruction_en":"Remove the dark blue slippers from the tiled walkway in the walkthrough and place them off the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地面上的深藍色拖鞋移走，放到走道外。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H9","instruction_en":"Remove the dark blue slippers from the floor in the walkthrough and place them off the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將走道地面上的深藍色拖鞋移走，放到走道外。"}
